name: Paris Manga & Sci-Fi Show
blurb: Twice-yearly Paris pop-culture convention covering manga, sci-fi, cosplay and comics, now held at Paris-Nord Villepinte.

last.venue: Parc des Expositions de Paris-Nord Villepinte

notes: The brand relocated from Porte de Versailles to Paris-Nord Villepinte in December 2022, so the seed venue is stale. Its most recent edition ran 3-4 October 2026 (homepage still flagged it 'ÉVÉNEMENT EN COURS' at research time), which is already over as of the 2026-10-05 window. The homepage's 'NOS EVENTS' tiles (28-29 Nov, 13-14 Jun, 11-12 Apr, 31 Oct-1 Nov) are cross-promotion for sibling TGS-group shows in other cities — one of them, 28-29 Nov 2026, is confirmed to be Toulouse Game Show, not a second Paris Manga date — and a targeted search found no next Paris Manga & Sci-Fi Show date announced yet, so editions is empty. The 53 guests seen on /invites (Christopher Lloyd, Ed Westwick, Tyler Hoechlin, Hélène Rollès, etc.) belong to the just-finished October 2026 edition and are not carried over.
